body.name: Deterministic-limit pilot annotation procedures
body.construction: \(\mathfrak A_{\mathrm{det}}=\{(\mathcal A_n)_{n\ge1}:\mathcal A_n\text{ uses an independent fully labeled pilot of size }m_n,\text{ selects a measurable rate in }\mathcal R_B,\text{ labels main-wave outcomes independently by that rate, and satisfies }\mathrm{ass:pilot-vanishes},\mathrm{ass:deterministic-rate-limit}\}\).
